insights: **Weekly Highlights —** Reshoevn8r US delivered $41,670 in total sales for Week 46 on 1439 units, versus $44,224 the prior week (-5.8% WoW). Organic sales grew +4.8% WoW to $26,459, and the Waterproof Shoe Spray was the standout at $11,170 (+12.9%) on 493 units, with its CVR rising to 28.1%. Sunday, Nov 8 was the peak day at $7,159.

**Metrics to Watch —** PPC revenue eased to $15,210 (-19.8%), which drove most of the dip in total sales. The Signature Kit came in at $5,553 (-16.2%) as sessions fell -53.7% to 1023, although its CVR improved +80.7% to 10.0%, so restoring traffic is the main lever. The Essential Kit held steady at $12,207 (-7.5%) on flat sessions of 1644 (+0.4%).

**Ad Spend Efficiency —** Ad spend of $5,128 (down from $5,649) produced $15,210 in PPC revenue for a 2.97x ROAS (prior 3.36x) and 33.7% ACOS. TACoS improved to 12.3% from 12.78%, and ad conversion is healthy at 15.83% on a 0.31% ad CTR.

**Actions This Week —** We will rebuild traffic to the Signature Kit with targeted Sponsored Products and Sponsored Brands campaigns to capitalize on its improved 10.0% CVR, and scale budget behind the Waterproof Shoe Spray while it converts at 28.1%. We will also test fresh ad creative to lift ad CTR above 0.31% and trim low-converting search terms to bring ROAS back toward 3.36x heading into the holiday season.
